coordinates: percent of 16:9 output; 1 unit = width/100 horizontally, height/100 vertically

segments.note: 12 opaque fill swatches (rows of 6) on gray 128; edge lines alpha 0. Color pipeline calibration.
White lines on dark: ThicknessScale 0.5/1/2/4 horizontal, vertical, diagonal, near-point stroke.
TypeId2 circles: diameter endpoints vertical, diameters 8/20/40 (scale1) and 20 (scale3).
TypeId3: symmetric arc, near-straight, returning cusp (start==end).
Glow 12/20 on circle, curve and near-point stroke.
Crossing glowing lines: left independent, right grouped (AO13 Index0 child of AO12 Index0).
Fill alpha 128 red over/under alpha 128 blue on white; opaque green with half-alpha red overlap.
Shapes crossing right/top/left output edges (negative/over-100 coordinates kept).
